The triangle rule or parallelogram rule

question.prompt: Which rule can be used for adding vectors in space?

solutions.explanation: The triangle rule or parallelogram rule can still be used for adding vectors in space, just as for vectors in a plane.
solutions.title: Recognize the geometric addition rules
